name: Combinatorial Invariant Disguise (Partition Maximization)
description: Instead of explicitly asking to connect targets (or using linear functionals evaluating to zero, which models translate to $f(u)=f(v)$), the problem uses partitions. The edges are equivalence rules. The connectivity requirement is disguised as a combinatorial invariant: the maximum number of groups in a valid partition must remain unchanged if the targets are forced into the same group. This requires non-trivial mathematical deduction to reduce back to connected components.
